resolution_codes.Fixed: Root cause found and removed (patch, config, data fix deployed and verified).
resolution_codes.Duplicate: Same root cause as another ticket. Requires duplicate_of.
resolution_codes.Invalid: Not a real defect (wrong report, misconfiguration, user error).
resolution_codes.Incomplete: Cannot act: missing info past the waiting period.
resolution_codes.Won't Fix: Real, but fix declined (cost/risk/obsolete). Requires decision_owner + reason.
resolution_codes.Cancelled: Request withdrawn or no longer needed.
resolution_codes.External: Fixed/resolved by a third party. Requires external_ref.
resolution_codes.Not Applicable: Out of scope for this project.

resolution_note.subject: == RESOLUTION RECORD · #{{issue_id}} {{subject}} ==
